rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying or describing something in a euphemistic way.

example.english: Euphemistically, their performance this time was really not very good.
example.traditional: 委婉咁講，佢今次嘅表現真係麻麻哋。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun2 gam3 gong2 keoi5 gam1 ci3 ge3 biu2 jin6 zan1 hai6 maa4 maa2 dei6

rows.note: Use this when euphemistically means presenting something in a nicer-sounding or less blunt way.

example.english: Putting it euphemistically, they are just quite direct; put less euphemistically, they are rude.
example.traditional: 好聽啲咁講，佢只係比較直接；難聽啲講就係冇禮貌。
example.jyutping: hou2 teng1 di1 gam3 gong2 keoi5 zi2 hai6 bei2 gaau3 zik6 zip3 naan4 teng1 di1 gong2 zau6 hai6 mou5 lai5 maau6
